runtime_acceptance: Physical Quest 2/3 test and educator review pending; asset visual review approved 8/10.
what: Externally textured horse and cow for secondary school: select ten regions, move illustrative joints, detach, rotate and replace surface pieces in Three.js/WebXR.
dims_source: Nominal dimensions from licensed Grab3D CC0 source meshes; not a measured anatomical specimen.
pivot: Ground-level centered root; detachable pieces centered on their geometry with saved assembly transform.
collider: Visible surface raycast; no rigid-body collision or clinical forces.
states: detached segment with neutral closure visible

views.primary: Eye-height within roughly 1–3m in Quest, desktop orbit, front/side/rear/three-quarter and separated/wireframe review in the actual Three.js application.

style_notes: Natural PBR coat, restrained cyan selection outline, soft grounding shadow. No decorative hologram effect over the whole animal. Do not imply internal muscles, bones or surgical accuracy.
